reference: By closing time he will have checked every ring on that table.
sk: Do zatvárania skontroluje každý prsteň na tom stole.
cz: Do zavíračky zkontroluje každý prsten na tom stole.

mistakes.text: By closing time he will check every ring on that table.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „By closing time“ znamená hotové do zatvárania, preto Future Perfect: „will have checked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „By closing time“ znamená hotové do zavíračky, proto Future Perfect: „will have checked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “By closing time” means complete before then, so use the Future Perfect: “will have checked”.

mistakes.text: By closing time he will have check every ring on that table.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “will have” use the past participle: “checked”.

mistakes.text: Until closing time he will have checked every ring on that table.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Do zatvárania“ v zmysle „najneskôr“ je „by closing time“, nie „until“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Do zavíračky“ ve smyslu „nejpozději“ je „by closing time“, ne „until“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Until” means the action continues up to that time; for a deadline use “by closing time”.

mistakes.text: By closing time he will have checked every rings on that table.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Every” is followed by a singular noun: “every ring”.

mistakes.text: By the closing time he will have checked every ring on that table.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V spojení „by closing time“ sa člen „the“ nepíše.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Ve spojení „by closing time“ se člen „the“ nepíše.
mistakes.feedback_en: No article in the phrase “by closing time”.
